summary: Proceed as an okc check with no companions: the design is sound, gated per band and readable from the decode_16/32 sliding rows. It is the same FUSED_PRE fold DIAGNOSIS lists as do-not-try for full decode (+3.1/+3.2 us at full B=16, ~0 at B=32), so expect roughly 1.0-1.15x per row and +0.3-1.0% headline. Two build traps (load_prefix_pseudo has an empty body in the skF TU; the dynamic-smem attribute is set for one kernel only) and a missing window-edge self-check must be fixed before dispatch.
justification: Removing the separate _pre_attention_kernel node is a real lever on these latency-bound rows (sliding decode_32 17.80 us = sk 14.1 + pre 1.9; decode_16 15.24 us Triton 12.6), but the fold adds in-kernel cost (skF measured +3.2 us at full B=16). Gate budgets: B=32 fold <= 2.4 us, B=16 <= 2.1-2.7 us: each band close to a coin flip. M2 (decode_32 <= 15.5 us) is the operative milestone; M3 is unreachable at these sizes. The difference from full-decode-splitkv-s3-fused-preattn is real at B=2..16 (bar is Triton's single launch).
